scope: Actual published default TypeScript Temporal namespace versus temporal-polyfill 1.0.7 basic ISO/Gregorian implementation and @js-temporal/polyfill 0.5.1. Same 48 public workloads retained from previous facade benchmark. TS uses compact ICU4X lunisolar arithmetic/data, host Intl Umm al-Qura and named timezones. ISO date and zoned cases; no non-ISO throughput claim. Hot operations exclude startup. Selected profiles allow independent fresh processes. No native backend installed.
method: Four sequential fresh Node processes in TS/basic/official/TS order. Two TS profiles, one fresh profile per reference; this is not final repeated reference verification. 20000 warmup,9x50000 calls,transition1000 warmup/9x5000; each has eight varying inputs and parity. No concurrent tests/builds/profiler. References freshly measured, no retained samples mixed into this comparison.
typescriptAggregation: Median of two fresh process medians; both nine-sample arrays and chronological per-process arrays retained. One fresh nine-sample process for each reference. Final repeated reference verification remains open.
